responsibility: This is the main build recipe template for the GCC compiler proper. Generated by configure into gcc/Makefile, it orchestrates host and target builds, generated-file dependencies, language subdirectories, documentation and localization targets, testsuite and QMTest execution, installation rules, and maintenance targets such as TAGS and dependency inclusion. It is the central build-time integration point that ties together configuration substitutions, per-language make fragments, generated headers/options, and the staged compiler build products in the gcc/ subdirectory.
